title: GatewayReply
description: The Gateway's reply to a permitted call. It carries the routing the Gateway resolved and the advisory content, and nothing that could widen its own authority: use case, region, risk tier and authority on the resulting record are the ones the caller sent (ADR-0006 §2.7). A reply missing any routing field is discarded by the Go client as unevidenced.
$comment: Go: backend/internal/adapter/gateway/grpc.go (wireReply). Python: ztax_gateway.wire.encode_reply. Decimal values are canonical strings, never JSON numbers (ADR-0006 §2.3).

confidence.description: A canonical decimal string in [0, 1], or empty.
